Fields.Name: Award Item Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag set to ON once anything in this item lot is acquired; it also serves as the acquisition flag for every slot without its own flag. Below 0: no flag.

Fields.Name: Cumulative Award Item Flag
Fields.Description: First of 8 consecutive event flags that store the number of rolls made on this row, for cumulative lots.

Fields.Name: Cumulative Max Draw Count
Fields.Description: Number of rolls at which a cumulative lot reaches its Accumulation Weights. 0: no accumulation.

Fields.Name: Rarity
Fields.Description: Determines the SFX used to display the rarity of the treasure lot.

Fields.Name: Is Direct to Inventory
